title: Cosmic Neural Flower
description: A vibrant multicolored mosaic flower with a glowing core floats inside a transparent crystalline sphere. The sphere is surrounded by glowing blue neuron-like structures with branching tendrils and spherical nodes, set against a cosmic nebula background with swirling iridescent ripples below.
prompt: A luminous mosaic flower with multicolored pixelated petals and a glowing core floats inside a large transparent glass sphere. Electric blue neuron-like structures with branching dendrites and glowing spherical nodes wrap around and through the sphere. The flower has long purple tendrils extending downward into swirling iridescent liquid ripples that reflect the scene. Set in a vibrant cosmic space with purple and pink nebulae and stars.
